description: Catalog of ground TYPES for the biome ground layer (G3). Each type drives the living_ground shader's base earth + displacement + emission. Per-cell explicit override via map_data.json's `ground_paint` layer; otherwise inferred from biome_paint kingdom (kingdom_to_ground) or stage terrain_mode (terrain_mode_to_ground). v2 adds the inference tables.

kingdom_to_ground._note: When a cell has biome_paint but no explicit ground_paint, infer ground type from the kingdom. Keys match biome_paint_tokens.gd KINGDOM constants and short tokens.

terrain_mode_to_ground._note: Last-resort fallback for cells with neither ground_paint nor biome_paint. Reads soft_stages.json's terrain_mode for the current sequence.

soil.label: Soil
soil.notes: Default warm earth — neutral organic ground.

moss.label: Moss
moss.notes: Living forest floor — green-on-dark, slight breathing.

stone.label: Stone
stone.notes: Hard cool grey — no displacement, mineral tones.

sand.label: Sand
sand.notes: Warm pale grain — gentle ripples in displacement.

snow.label: Snow
snow.notes: Cold blue-white — drifts in displacement, faint emission.

ash.label: Ash
ash.notes: Burnt earth — dark with faint warm embers, dry crack pattern.

wood.label: Wood
wood.notes: Forest detritus / fallen logs — rich brown with bark grain.

void.label: Void
void.notes: Cavern entrance / underground hint — dark with subtle blue glow. Future: triggers marching-cube cave generator (G5).
